I can't move between the cards with the arrow keys anymore. Could you bring that back and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and the other documents in docs/ for this project's requirements.

Verification passed: type checking, all 138 unit tests, and all 76 browser tests, including keyboard play, focus scrolling, touch input, and snapshot resume.

The changed files pass formatting. The repository-wide format check still reports 13 unrelated files.
